_comment: Copy to config/dispatch.local.json (gitignored) for tools/dispatch/dispatch.mjs. hostNames = machines (os.hostname()) allowed to really dispatch / steer; hostLabel = how task books name that machine. commandCenterConfig = the command-center config this reuses for the tracker root, graphqlUrl, quota readings and the cars export (one source; relative = repo root). lines = alias → parent issue + team for new child issues; the parent is re-checked against the tracker on every dispatch, so when the owner re-parents issues only this alias table may need an edit. pools: configDir per pool; overage = paid overage on (cars keep running past caps; guardTagsFile gets the tag appended before launch); secretary = never auto-picked; env = extra env for cars on that pool. poolRules override the defaults in tools/dispatch/pool-pick.mjs. backfill = only for tools/dispatch/backfill-issue-map.mjs.
